# REL-39: Webhooks: subscriptions, HMAC-signed delivery, retries with backoff, delivery log

Status: **Done** | Phase 3 - Integrations | Owner: Claude | issue #30

## Outcome

Webhooks: subscriptions, HMAC-signed delivery, retries with backoff, delivery log

## Depends on

- [REL-57](REL-57.md) Incident and dashboard follow-ups: affected count, paged detail, missing guardrail panels, one success rate - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-40](REL-40.md) Developer documentation from the OpenAPI spec with a quickstart

## Acceptance

- [x] Subscriber receives a signed event for a payment state change
- [x] Failed deliveries retry with backoff and are visible in a delivery log
- [x] Subscriptions filter by event type
- [x] Delivery failure and retry behavior are documented
- [x] Webhooks follow ADR-0015 (owner decision 2026-11-04): a `webhooks` container with its own consumer group stores each delivery (attempt, status, next attempt, last response) in the same transaction as its bookkeeping and acknowledges after the commit, so a crash loses nothing and a duplicate stream entry produces one delivery
- [x] Each delivery carries `Relay-Event-Id` and `Relay-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 hex of t.body>`; the body never includes the payment description; retries back off exponentially (settings, at most 8 attempts, then `failed`) and every attempt is in the delivery log with a retention setting
- [x] Subscription URLs must be http(s) to a host in `WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (default: the local demo sink and localhost), checked at creation and at send time; anything else is 422 and never fetched (server-side request forgery)
- [x] The signing secret is generated by Relay, returned only in the create response, and never returned again or logged; the subscription API requires the key; a demo sink runs under a compose profile; the new container has a restart policy, health check and per-service variables covered by the compose test; deliveries are counted in a metric scraped by Prometheus

## Steps

1. **REL-39.1 Write failing webhook tests** (done) - Cover subscription CRUD, a valid HMAC signature on delivery, backoff schedule after failures, and delivery log entries.
2. **REL-39.2 Add subscription models and endpoints** (done) - In `api/app/webhooks/`, register a URL, secret and event types with a migration.
3. **REL-39.3 Sign deliveries with HMAC** (done) - Send a timestamped SHA-256 HMAC header so subscribers can verify authenticity.
4. **REL-39.4 Deliver from the event stream with retries** (done) - Consume payment events and retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff up to a limit.
5. **REL-39.5 Add the delivery log** (done) - Record each attempt with status and response; expose it via the API. `api-tests` pass.
6. **REL-39.6 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - CI is green, the reviewer confirms correctness against the requirements, the maintainer approves, and the pull request is squash-merged with the issue closed.
